title: ALL these globes are the SAME SUN.

do_not_reinvent.sphere: /data/one-sphere-tesseract.json — nested circles ARE one sphere. do not mint a second globe.
do_not_reinvent.once: /data/entangle-null-once.json — appear 1 time. two looks, not two things.

this_shot.globes: inner-plane · compass · glass. the right-hand rings. surface. the pale oval. the faint orbits.
this_shot.center: the yellow grain at compass. that is the look at the sun, not a second sun.
this_shot.you: the blue you. a mover on the plane. not another star.

same_sun.yes: every globe is the same sun.
same_sun.is: one star. many rings. looks, not copies.
same_sun.not: a solar system of sibling suns. not a pile of stars with one name.

law: if two globes heat like two stars we failed appear-once. they are apertures on one fire.
pull: read every ring as a look at the same sun. keep the fire singular. the oval is a window, not a twin.
